integrity: The exact all-length proof is by a distinct-subsequence recurrence and run telescoping; the standalone checker provides additional finite corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three linear deletions from words starting 10 avoiding 00 and 111, length at least three; Fibonacci specialization m>=3. No capacity or extremal code claim, no unrestricted-source extension. Earlier unindexed equivalent work not ruled out.
title: Arrangement rigidity for three-deletion descendants of constrained binary words
